balance.n: USDA PSD, Coffee, Green: the world is the sum of the countries the file lists (it has no world row); domestic use is the PSD attribute 'Domestic Consumption'. Stocks-to-use is ending stocks divided by domestic use, exports not counted. The PSD file carries no label: the atlas calls the newest marketing year the forecast and the one before it the estimate (the atlas's words; USDA's World Agricultural Production circular, https://apps.fas.usda.gov/psdonline/circulars/production.pdf, heads the same two years 'Prel.' and 'Proj.' in its tables)

notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market year 2026/27, a forecast (trader reference). Years differ.
PSD coffee exports/imports include roasted and soluble coffee in green-bean equivalent; BACI flows are green beans only (HS 0901.11/12).
Trade of roasted coffee (HS 090121, 090122) and of coffee extracts and soluble coffee (HS 210110) is not among the customs groups of the atlas, so no table of processed coffee is shown yet.
